description_full:
Internship Opportunity at EKONID (ProRecognition)

EKONID is looking for a motivated intern to support the ProRecognition project, focusing on Skilled Migration and the recognition of foreign qualifications for employment in Germany.

The six-month internship will involve project administration, social media content development, and support for events and communication activities.

Location: EKONID Office, Jakarta
Duration: 6 months
Application deadline: 15 November 2026

Scan QR for more information.
